title: cephalanthera grandiflora
intro: Cephalanthera grandiflora, commonly known as the large-flowered Helleborine, is a species of flowering plant in the family Orchidaceae. This terrestrial orchid is native to Europe and Western Asia, and is known for its showy, white or pale yellow flowers. The large-flowered Helleborine has been used in traditional medicine for its potential health benefits, which include anti-inflammatory and antimicrobial properties that may aid in wound healing and the treatment of respiratory issues. The bioactive constituents of this plant include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and alkaloids, which are believed to contribute to its therapeutic actions, including antioxidant and vasodilatory effects.
